About Me

The person behind Mizan Promo

I'm Md Mizanur Rahman, a digital marketer, video editor, and creative growth specialist.

I work with musicians, independent artists, content creators, and businesses to build stronger digital identities and reach their audiences. From a song that deserves more listeners to a channel that needs a clear growth plan, I focus on honest strategy, clean creative work, and communication you can rely on.

I also offer my services on Fiverr as a Level 1 seller, where clients rate my work 4.9 out of 5 across 38 reviews — every project handled personally, every promise kept realistic and policy-safe.

My approach

Our Process

How every project runs

A simple, transparent four-step process — you always know what happens next and what you're paying for.

01

Discovery

We talk first. I learn your goals, your audience, and exactly what you need — before any money is discussed.

02

Strategy

You get a clear plan: what will be done, in what order, on what timeline, and what result it aims for — honestly stated.

03

Execution

I create and deliver the agreed work, keeping you updated as it progresses — no silence, no surprises.

04

Review & Improvement

We review the delivered work together, check it against the goal, and improve anything that can be better.
